item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be replaced by a strong easterly airstream gradually. It will be windy over the region in the next couple of days. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few rain patches over southern China towards the weekend. A maritime airstream is expected to bring mild and humid weather to the coast of Guangdong early next week. The visibility will be relatively low over the region. Another surge of the monsoon will reach Guangdong later next Monday.
